content.guideline_title: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery Guideline
content.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
key_points: Emphasis on the safety of 'bridging' with antiplatelet therapy for patients on coronary stents before non-cardiac surgery.
Evaluations of different antiplatelet therapies and their effects on perioperative outcomes.
Recommendations regarding perioperative bridging anticoagulation in patients with atrial fibrillation.
Discussion on the management of patients with mechanical heart valves undergoing non-cardiac interventions.
